Population increased in Test Valley

The estimated population of Test Valley in 2024 was 135,201 usual residents, a rise of 0.6% since 2023.

This meant that Test Valley's rate of population change placed it about average among local authority districts in England and Wales.

In the period from mid-2021 to mid-2024, the population estimate of Test Valley increased by 3.1%.

Over this slightly longer period, Test Valley was also among the areas that had a broadly average population increase, of local authority districts in England and Wales.

Age profile of Test Valley

The average (median) age rose to 44.1 years between 2023 and 2024.

You can see how the age profile of Test Valley has changed since 2011 in the population pyramid below.

sections.content:
Test Valley is an area that is classed as intermediate urban in nature according to the 2021 Census Rural Urban Classification.

By age category, Test Valley's population of 135,201 usual residents was made up of:

  • 24,529 people aged 0 to 15 years, (18.1%)
  • 80,977 people aged 16 to 64 years, (59.9%)
  • 29,695 people aged 65 years and over, (22%)

    • Compared with England and Wales as a whole, Test Valley has a slightly higher proportion of people aged 65 years and over (22% compared with 18.9% for England and Wales).

Contributors to population change

We look at different flows of people into and out of areas and births and deaths to see what is driving population change in each area.

In Test Valley, the largest contribution to population change in the year to mid-2024 was from net international migration.

sections.title: Contributors to population change in Test Valley
sections.subtitle: How the population changed, by component

sections.content:
We estimate that, for Test Valley, between 2023 and 2024:

  • More deaths than births led to a fall in the population of 63 people (0%). In total, there were 1,224 births and 1,287 deaths in Test Valley.
  • Net internal migration (people moving to and from other areas in the UK) increased the population by 411 (0.3%). There were 7,533 people entering the area and 7,122 people leaving the area.
  • Net international migration led to an increase in Test Valley's population of 488 (0.4%) as a result of 910 people entering the area and 422 people leaving the area.
  • Other change (which includes changes to armed forces personnel and prisoners) for Test Valley was less than 0.1%.

Revisions to 2023 population estimates

We regularly revise our initial population estimates as we get more data and methods improve.

Our revised estimate for the population of Test Valley in mid-2023 is 134,336.

Within this, international migration was revised upwards by 326 people and internal migration estimates were revised downwards by 451 people.

Overall, there was an revision downwards of 125 people.
